scope: Independent visual review of selected new native components and exported contact/scene previews, plus separate file/RGBA/invariant/geometry reports. Not Unity execution.

findings.evidence: Native4 and direction/state contact2 viewed. Diamond/square bolt heads, chamfered corners and straight frame/bar/arrow/X edges replace V01 softened fittings.
Thin right-angle rails leave a large recognizable lane; small diagonal wedge is internal, not a solid block. Brake pads show transverse chamfered stopbars with no transport arrow.
Four headings agree between deck, arrow, printed guide and scroll. Fully-open gate base clear, denied retains closed bar plus sharp X.
Source atlas surround is not a runtime sky or production shape. Runtime crops have transparent padding. No smooth-circle primitive observed in native selected component silhouettes.
